title: Use of Medisave for Terminal Illnesses and End-stage Diseases
what_it_is: Use of Medisave for Terminal Illnesses and End-stage Diseases

sections.label: Palliative care subsidies and MediSave
sections.summary: Palliative care is subsidised and patients can use MediSave, with raised withdrawal limits for hospices and home care.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Care options for patients with terminal illnesses and end-stage diseases include palliative treatment at home or in a hospice.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Palliative care is subsidised and patients can tap on MediSave to pay for the remaining copayment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) recently raised the MediSave limits so that patients can tap on more MediSave for palliative care needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In January 2015, the MediSave withdrawal limit for inpatient hospices was increased from $160 per day to $200 per day.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There are no daily limits for home palliative care but there is a lifetime MediSave withdrawal limit which was increased from $1,500 to $2,500.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Patients can use their own or their immediate family members' MediSave.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: However, if the patient passes away in the hospice, he may use all the available balance in his own MediSave account for the final inpatient hospice bill without any daily limit.

sections.label: Out-of-pocket payments for palliative care
sections.summary: About eight in 10 inpatient hospice bills and nine in 10 home palliative care bills had no out-of-pocket payments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Overall, about eight out of 10 inpatient hospice bills did not have out-of-pocket payments while about nine in 10 home palliative care patients did not have to make out-of-pocket payment for their bills.

sections.label: Additional assistance applications
sections.summary: Patients could approach the social worker to apply for additional assistance under MediFund or Medication Assistance Fund.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For such instances, patients could approach the social worker to apply for additional assistance under MediFund or Medication Assistance Fund.
